description: Policy review 2026-10-03 (§5.2, criterion 5; Academic Code §4.5): a transfer the DGS pre-approved in the course rules is counted, but the credit is final only once the Graduate School has approved it and the Grad Admin has recorded it — so the §5.2 row reads “Graduate School approval pending” (in progress, not met) until the student ticks that it was recorded, and its line says when the request can go: after the first semester, before the conferral semester.
